mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a master suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total costs depend heavily on square footage, foundation requirements, and your chosen finishes for the en-suite bathroom. Custom tilework, freestanding tubs, dual-sink vanities, and high-end fixtures substantially increase the budget compared to a standard bedroom extension. Additionally, tying new plumbing lines into existing water and sewer lines, as well as modifying roofing lines to blend seamlessly with existing architecture, play major roles in the final estimate. Firm pricing is established during the design and estimating consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key cost factors include the addition's square footage, foundation requirements, roofline tie-ins, and the plumbing and finish selections chosen for the en-suite bathroom.
